verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an official Core RESTful API and a Core JavaScript SDK plus a CLI (pspace) for programmatic interaction with Paperspace resources, which supports SDK-driven, agentic workflows. However, evidence is thin: only one SDK language (JavaScript) is documented, no OpenAPI/spec discovery works (probe-3 shows 404s), and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usage or quality. missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage (e.g., Python), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and community validation of SDK reliability.
